title: Coefficient accuracy for a finite family
statement: Let $\mathcal F$ be a nonempty finite family of subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and let $\varepsilon$ be a rational number with $0<\varepsilon\leq\tfrac12$. The coefficient-accuracy parameter is $\varepsilon/(2|\mathcal F|)$, where $|\mathcal F|$ is the cardinality of $\mathcal F$.
hypotheses_covered: $\mathcal F$ is a finite family of subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$
